title: Conquest of the Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera (1508)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Conquest of the Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera (1508)", at revision 1370612813, opens: "The first conquest of the Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera was undertaken on 23 July 1508 by a Spanish fleet under the command of Pedro Navarro." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q106313831, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1508 conquest". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
